source_identity.scope: Imported Python source files used in this local replay matched the active public-service release. Runtime configuration, dependencies, production data and performance were not matched or retested.

counting_note: 500 verdicts in 25 sequential local requests, including repeated question templates and input variants. Not 500 independent new questions and not a new LLM comparison or concurrency test.
replay_input_note: A, B and D reused saved request payloads. C and E were regenerated from the archived deterministic generators with local synthetic namespaces; expected answers were checked against saved expectations. E shape also matched the saved shape.
